rules.eyebrow: AN HONEST LOOK AT THE GAME
rules.implementedBody: Rooms without registration; SQLite saves; secret orders; special token limits; raids; sequential marches; transport through your fleets; basic combat with cards, own-house support and casualties; retreats; power collection; multiple rounds and game completion. Bots play these phases at three difficulty levels.
rules.inDevelopment: A complete game with all original rules is still in development.
rules.missingBody: Third-house support, routed units, full port rules and the step-by-step presentation of every attack are not implemented yet. Each March action currently has one destination. Final tiebreakers are simplified. Expansions remain disabled until their rules are implemented.
rules.missingTitle: What is still missing from the full board game
rules.prototypeNotice: Tactical prototype: planning → raids → marches → combat → new rounds and base card abilities. Westeros phases and expansions are not implemented yet.
rules.serverAuthority: The Go server stores game state, secret orders, timers and bot decisions. The original rules are not fully implemented yet.
rules.title: Rules and scenarios
rules.tutorialBody: The tutorial follows the original game's stages and this interface. Original Unity scenes do not run in the browser. Installed-game artwork is served through a local read-only volume and is not included in the image. Interface localization does not translate text embedded in original images.

tracks.title: Influence tracks
tutorial.actionsBody: Confirm orders after planning. For a march, select the ordered area, unit counts and a target on the board. A raid removes an eligible adjacent order.
tutorial.boardBody: Drag with the left mouse button or one finger to pan. Use the wheel or a two-finger gesture to zoom. Right-drag or use two fingers to rotate while keeping the tilt. Table fits the whole board. Confirm marches below the board. You can hide the Houses and Area panels and your hand.
tutorial.cardsBody: Your hand is at the bottom, sorted by strength. Select a card to inspect it; collapse the hand to give the board more space. Combat cards are chosen secretly. Cards, units, orders and your own support determine the winner.
tutorial.helpBody: Open the cog menu and choose Tutorial to take the tour again. Language, sound, animations, room settings and game rules are available here too.
tutorial.housesBody: This panel lists human players and bots. The host can replace bots with friends before starting. Castles show progress toward victory.
tutorial.ordersBody: Only orders allowed by the server are shown here. Used tokens, the King's Court limit and terrain type are considered. Hover, focus or tap for an explanation. Tap the same order again to remove it before confirming readiness.
tutorial.phasesBody: Everyone first assigns secret orders, then reveals them simultaneously. Raids and marches follow in Iron Throne order.
tutorial.timerBody: By default you have 5 minutes with a soft timer: you can keep thinking after zero. The host can enable a hard timer in settings before starting.
